description: Search every transcript this guruling learned for words: all of them must appear, case ignored, each at the start of a word (so "pric" finds "pricing"; a word of three letters or fewer, like "AI", only whole); put a phrase in double quotes to keep it whole. Answers the videos with the most mentions first, each with its date, video id and short snippets. It matches words, not meaning: when little comes back, search again with other words for the same thing (a synonym, the singular, fewer words).

query.description: Words to find, e.g. pricing "cold email"

name: search_transcripts
title: Search the transcripts
